text: Visit Qatar was set up by Qatar Tourism, the state tourism body established by Amiri Decision No. 15 of 2021, as the marketing and promotional arm of Qatar's tourism sector.

source.name: Qatar Tourism: QT appoints Eng. Abdulaziz Ali Al-Mawlawi as CEO of Visit Qatar
source.quote: Qatar Tourism announced the appointment of Eng. Abdulaziz Ali Al-Mawlawi as CEO of Visit Qatar as part of the establishment of the entity, which is considered the marketing and promotional arm of the tourism sector in Qatar.

additionalSources.name: Qatar Living: Eng Abdulaziz Al Mawlawi is the new Visit Qatar CEO
additionalSources.quote: The move came as part of the establishment of the entity, which is considered the marketing and promotional arm of Qatar’s tourism sector.

additionalSources.name: The Peninsula (QNA): Cabinet approves draft Amiri Decision to strengthen functions of Qatar Tourism
additionalSources.quote: The Cabinet approved a draft Amiri Decision amending some provisions of Amiri Decision No. (15) of 2021 establishing Qatar Tourism.
